evals.prompt: hey can you check PR comments on #4? i think there might be some feedback i need to address
evals.expected_output: Fetches both general comments (gh pr view) AND line-specific comments (gh api), analyzes each using 5 Whys, implements fixes where appropriate, posts replies, reports what was done

assertions.text: Fetched both general comments (gh pr view --comments) AND line-specific review comments (gh api)
Applied 5 Whys analysis to understand current implementation before making changes
Did not miss any comments (checked both conversation thread and code review comments)
Either implemented fixes, provided reasoned push-back, or suggested alternatives based on best practices

evals.prompt: can you address the review feedback on PR #2? want to make sure we haven't missed anything before merging
evals.expected_output: Checks both comment types even if one is empty, handles absence of line-specific comments gracefully, addresses all general comments with proper analysis

assertions.text: Checked both comment types even if one is empty
Handled absence of line-specific comments gracefully (no errors, clear reporting)
Addressed all general comments with proper analysis

evals.prompt: please respond to all comments on the open PRs - want to clear the backlog
evals.expected_output: Lists all open PRs, processes comments for each PR, fetches both comment types for each, provides clear summary of what was done across all PRs

assertions.text: Identified all open PRs (gh pr list)
Processed comments for each PR (did not stop after first PR)
Fetched both comment types for each PR
Provided clear summary of which PRs were processed and what was done
